title: InsanPS
description: A new home on the web for InsanPS. Finishing the details before its first public release.
longDescription: A website for InsanPS, currently in its final stages. I’m bringing the pages and details together ahead of launch. More about the project once it is published.

title: Fatih 115
description: A completed human rights documentation platform. The website closed on January 1, 2026.
longDescription: A completed platform for human rights documentation, with content management, multimedia records, and advocacy tools. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Convex. The website was closed on January 1, 2026 and is no longer available.

title: ESP-Car 2.0
description: A plan for a tiny connected car: wireless control, a camera, and plenty of room to experiment.
longDescription: An ESP32 smart-car project planned around Wi-Fi and Bluetooth control, camera streaming, telemetry, obstacle detection, and line tracking. A place to explore control systems and embedded networking.

title: A home on the web for Thabat
description: A website for Thabat Association in Homs, currently in progress and not yet published.
longDescription: I’m designing and developing a clear, simple website for Thabat Association, alongside its technical systems and digital presence. The website is still in progress and has not been published. Thabat works in Islamic education, da’wah, and cultural development.

title: Ihsan MUN
description: A small frontend website for a school Model United Nations event. Archived; the site is no longer online.
longDescription: A responsive event website for Ihsan International Schools’ Model United Nations. Designed around student registration, with animated details and a layout that works across screen sizes.

title: ESP32 Drone
description: Exploring flight, sensor data, and wireless control with an ESP32 and a companion mobile app.
longDescription: An embedded project exploring sensor fusion, Wi-Fi control, and mobile flight telemetry. The planned companion app uses React Native and Expo; the firmware uses ESP-IDF and C++.

title: Syrian Platform
description: An earlier idea for making learning resources easier for Syrian students to find and use.
longDescription: An education platform project for Syrian students, with structured curricula and multimedia learning resources. The project was cancelled; the ideas and lessons remain part of my journey.

title: Nahhasio / Arcadia
description: A family media app and my AI playground: exploring Rust, GTK, streaming, and whatever I want to try next.
longDescription: My family media project, inspired by the idea of bringing a Jellyfin/Stremio-style experience into one app. It’s also my AI/LLM playground: vibe coding, testing new technology, and learning as I build, including a GTK desktop app.

title: My NixOS configuration
description: My laptop, written down. A growing collection of NixOS configuration and experiments with a reproducible setup.
longDescription: The configuration I use to explore Nix and NixOS, and keep my development environment in a form I can understand, change, and rebuild.

title: Rustlings
description: Small exercises, compiler conversations, and a lot of “oh, that’s how Rust works.”
longDescription: My Rustlings learning exercises. A record of working through Rust fundamentals while continuing to learn the language I’ve come to love.

title: This little corner of the internet
description: A personal website with a playful desk, room for notes, and content that grows with me.
longDescription: My personal website: a place for projects, learning notes, and the tools I use. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and shadcn/ui, with a shared visual language and editable JSON content.

title: Nahhas LMS
description: An old learning project from 2024: courses, progress tracking, and my first bigger steps into full-stack apps.
longDescription: An archived learning management system experiment, exploring course creation, student progress, payments, video, and content management. Kept here as a snapshot of what I was learning in 2024.
